name: A stream with a blacksmith beyond, and a distant view of the church of S. Antonio, Macau
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of blacksmiths and other figures on the further bank of a stream; beyond the trees is the gabled façade of the church of S. Antonio (St Anthony), Macau. See E.1699-1928 for a similar view.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
